digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and provider routing
propositions: Four hand-built sub-call sites pass config=cfg without a model class binding, causing them to inherit cfg.model directly instead of honoring the configured model-class vocabulary.

overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic (18 of 23 LLM calls) and all bypass to direct Anthropic when a class-only Bedrock configuration is deployed, leaving the majority of plan-review traffic on the wrong provider.

ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path (enrich_drain called from event_append and push) and sends real ticket content to direct Anthropic on ordinary rebar create/comment operations without gate visibility.

When a model-class table is configured with values different from cfg.model, the four hand-built sub-calls must resolve to class-selected models, not cfg.model, as verified by test configuration that makes the two cases distinguishable strings.

Each of the three hand-built sub-call sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) must explicitly select its model from the class vocabulary with documented reasoning, while top-level ops' primary calls (review-ticket, spec-scan) remain correctly on cfg.model by design.
